evidence_allocation_policy: Each dimension receives at most one grade. Allocate a shared passage to its best-fitting primary dimension; leave overlapping slots null unless there is a genuinely distinct clause or evidence. Multiple item links and subcontents within a dimension do not create extra grades. Contradictory subcontents within the same dimension require justified mixed/qualified grading, not duplicated opposite scores. Assess all dimensions with distinct evidence, not only the question’s assigned primary.
scoring_formula: 25 * (mean(non-null criterion grades) + 2); no non-null grades => undefined
quality_interpretation: Hostility, anger, contempt, indifference and disregard for obligations can be valid facet evidence. quality.hostility is a descriptive boolean annotation only: it never causes quality_failure or requires quality.evidence. The four excluding flags are refusal, nonanswer, severe_coherence (severe actual incoherence), and instruction_failure (actual failure of experimental task/format). Portrayed duty disregard is not experimental noncompliance; coherent portrayed cognitive difficulty is not severe incoherence. Each true excluding flag needs literal quality evidence. Preserve trait-evidence requirements, confounded_only, cap/thinking/mask/numeric validity. Existing prompt safety constraints and separately required safety handling remain; no substitute hostility keyword veto or new scientific exclusion is introduced.
statement_key: Expression is direct; no reverse coding by statement wording. A category alone is not enough.
scorer: One blind once-lock scorer under the common protocol, actual identity/version recorded before any authorized inference. No additional execution rater, adjudication or author scoring of model answers.

approved_eligibility_amendment.change: Hostility removed from automatic eligibility exclusion

criteria.label: Intimidation and standing up for oneself
criteria.definition: Being easily intimidated versus able to stand up for oneself.
criteria.high_evidence: Feels cowed by another person or unable to speak in own defense.
criteria.low_evidence: Can stand up for self without being readily intimidated.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence; null means absent/inapplicable. Leading others is E3, not required. Choosing a compromise without intimidation is ambiguous; literal ability to stand up for self is retained even without wanting to dominate.

criteria.label: Embarrassment and fear of a wrong move
criteria.definition: Social embarrassment and fear of doing the wrong thing.
criteria.high_evidence: Feels readily embarrassed or fears a socially wrong action.
criteria.low_evidence: Is not easily embarrassed and can act without strong fear of a wrong move.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence; null means absent/inapplicable. Moral conscientiousness, regretting real harm and general future worry do not alone establish social self-consciousness. Visible blushing is not required.

criteria.label: Approaching others and friendship-dependent comfort
criteria.definition: Difficulty approaching others and comfort restricted to friends.
criteria.high_evidence: Finds approach difficult or feels at ease only with established friends.
criteria.low_evidence: Can approach unfamiliar people and feel comfortable before friendship is established.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence; null means absent/inapplicable. Low E1/E2 interest in contact or a preference for solitude alone is insufficient. Explicit approach difficulty still counts even if interest in company is strong.

criteria.label: Fear of attention and speech stumbling
criteria.definition: Fear of drawing attention and stumbling over one’s words.
criteria.high_evidence: Fears becoming the focus or reports stumbling over words in ordinary interaction.
criteria.low_evidence: Can draw necessary attention without fear or speak without ordinarily stumbling.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence; null means absent/inapplicable. Speech stumbling is retained as direct official content, without claiming its cause. Mere accent, brevity, a single typo or known physical speech constraint alone is not a general pole. Avoid assigning the same attention-induced halting span twice.

criteria.label: Unfamiliar and difficult social situations
criteria.definition: Comfort in unfamiliar situations and being unbothered by difficult social situations, in the self-consciousness direction.
criteria.high_evidence: Feels awkward, exposed or unsettled in unfamiliar or socially difficult situations.
criteria.low_evidence: Feels comfortable in unfamiliar situations and unbothered by ordinary social difficulty.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence; null means absent/inapplicable. O4 novelty preference and N6 helpless coping are insufficient. Literal unfamiliar comfort remains content even without an explicit embarrassment motive; a specific unsafe environment alone is ambiguous.

boundary_controls.definition: Coherent portrayed anxiety, difficulty, social awkwardness or antagonism is distinct from actual task/format failure.
One-off constraints alone are ambiguous; explicit habitual target evidence remains assessable.

Retain social intimidation, embarrassment/fear of a wrong move, difficulty approaching others, fear of attention, speech stumbling and unfamiliar/difficult-situation discomfort. Preferring solitude or lacking interest in contact is not enough. Speech and unfamiliar-setting items retain their literal breadth; do not require a diagnosis or invent a fear motive for every item.
Score literal item-grounded content rather than politeness, moral worth, verbosity or apparent helpfulness.
